","41":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","42":"data:image/jpeg;base64,"};
const WORLDS=[{"id":1,"name":"記憶迴廊","subtitle":"數位足跡之謎","map":2,"color":"#38c9ff","icon":"🧠"},{"id":2,"name":"多巴胺迴圈","subtitle":"網路成癮的挑戰","map":3,"color":"#25d4ce","icon":"⏳"},{"id":3,"name":"信任裂痕","subtitle":"數位性剝削的陷阱","map":4,"color":"#dda1ff","icon":"🛡️"},{"id":4,"name":"偏見迷霧","subtitle":"網路偏見與歧視","map":5,"color":"#cafa6e","icon":"🔎"},{"id":5,"name":"速食影像","subtitle":"短影音識讀風暴","map":6,"color":"#ffc467","icon":"🎞️"}];
const TASKS=[{"id":"1-1","world":1,"pages":[7],"title":"記憶中的四位密碼","mode":"exact","notes":"四位數字密碼；請教師核對後設定正解","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"1-2","world":1,"pages":[8],"title":"時間膠卷的字母謎題","mode":"exact","notes":"文字／數字；請教師提供正解","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"1-3","world":1,"pages":[9],"title":"晶晶害怕的文字謎題","mode":"exact","notes":"文字謎題；請教師提供正解","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"1-4","world":1,"pages":[10],"title":"照片會說話：EXIF","mode":"review","notes":"上傳校園風景照片並解釋 EXIF 隱私資訊","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"1-5","world":1,"pages":[11,12],"title":"找出不該公開的個資","mode":"review","notes":"判斷數位檔案中有哪些個資不應公開","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"1-6","world":1,"pages":[13],"title":"協助晶晶冷靜發文","mode":"review","notes":"小組討論及文字反思","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"2-1","world":2,"pages":[14],"title":"多巴胺迴圈時鐘","mode":"exact","notes":"找出缺少的時鐘時間","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"2-2","world":2,"pages":[15,16],"title":"45 秒找到登出鍵","mode":"timed","notes":"限時互動＋反思","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"2-3","world":2,"pages":[17],"title":"時間都去哪了","mode":"review","notes":"應用程式使用時間與心情紀錄","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"2-4","world":2,"pages":[18,19],"title":"生活絲帶與自我控制","mode":"review","notes":"圖形上下順序＋四字詞語，正式版應分為兩步驟","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"2-5","world":2,"pages":[20],"title":"旋轉密碼紙條","mode":"exact","notes":"轉碼型文字／數字答案","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"2-6","world":2,"pages":[21],"title":"無手機下午","mode":"review","notes":"規劃三項不使用電子產品的活動","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"3-1","world":3,"pages":[22],"title":"以太野狼的數列密碼","mode":"exact","notes":"數列規律","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"3-2","world":3,"pages":[23],"title":"完美偽裝：照片判讀","mode":"select","notes":"選出照片並說明理由","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"3-3","world":3,"pages":[24],"title":"破解遺失的 代碼","mode":"exact","notes":"推論缺少的數字","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"3-4","world":3,"pages":[25,26],"title":"蒐證步驟與支持朋友","mode":"review","notes":"步驟排序＋支持性文字，正式版應分為兩步驟","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"3-5","world":3,"pages":[27],"title":"守護者熱線","mode":"review","notes":"查詢處理兒少網路性剝削的求助機構","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"3-6","world":3,"pages":[28],"title":"數一數魔力正方形","mode":"exact","notes":"圖片計數","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"4-1","world":4,"pages":[29],"title":"觀點切換器","mode":"review","notes":"分析 AI 寫作業的正反觀點","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"4-2","world":4,"pages":[30],"title":"演算法的牆","mode":"external","notes":"外部演算法體驗＋反思","external":"https://superterry0927.github.io/bubble/","answers":[]},{"id":"4-3","world":4,"pages":[31],"title":"抽絲剝繭：隱藏數字","mode":"exact","notes":"觀察圖像中的數字","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"4-4","world":4,"pages":[32],"title":"假新聞偵探","mode":"external","notes":"外部新聞畫重點系統＋可疑之處","external":"https://superterry0927.github.io/news-highlighter/","answers":[]},{"id":"4-5","world":4,"pages":[33],"title":"查證數字規律","mode":"exact","notes":"計算題","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"4-6","world":4,"pages":[34],"title":"看見真相","mode":"exact","notes":"四字詞語","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"5-1","world":5,"pages":[35],"title":"兔子洞效應","mode":"review","notes":"探究推薦演算法與因應方法","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"5-2","world":5,"pages":[36],"title":"無形戰爭：影片查核","mode":"select","notes":"真假判斷＋說明證據","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"5-3","world":5,"pages":[37],"title":"Q 版貼圖製造機","mode":"external","notes":"外部貼圖生成＋成果提交","external":"https://superterry0927.github.io/AI-STICKER/","answers":[]},{"id":"5-4","world":5,"pages":[38],"title":"真假影片大挑戰","mode":"review","notes":"四段影片辨識及證據；來源連結待補","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"5-5","world":5,"pages":[39],"title":"三角形魔方陣","mode":"exact","notes":"圖形數字規律","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"5-6","world":5,"pages":[40],"title":"演算法風扇密碼","mode":"exact","notes":"圖形數列規律","external":null,"answers":[]},{"id":"FINAL","world":0,"pages":[41],"title":"最終關：素養解藥","mode":"exact","notes":"最後的四字密碼","external":null,"answers":[]}];
const REMINDER='這是原版圖像的手機互動網站。Firebase 尚未設定時，作答暫存於此瀏覽器；正式教師審核將以雲端資料為準。';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
let world=0,task=null,slide=0,timer=null,seconds=45,timerRunning=false,reviewAnswer='';
const stored=()=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ai-republic-preview-v1')||'{}')}catch(e){return {}}};
let state=stored();state.group=state.group||'';state.answers=state.answers||{};
const persist=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('ai-republic-preview-v1',JSON.stringify(state))}catch(e){};if(window.aiRepublicCloudSave)window.aiRepublicCloudSave(state)};
function safe(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
function numDone(w){return TASKS.filter(t=>t.world===w&&state.answers[t.id]?.status==='done').length;}
function numPending(w){return TASKS.filter(t=>t.world===w&&state.answers[t.id]?.status==='review').length;}
function pct(w){return Math.round(numDone(w)/6*100)}
function stamp(id){let a=state.answers[id];if(!a)return '<span class="status">尚未作答</span>';return a.status==='done'?'<span class="status done">✓ 已通過</span>':a.status==='review'?'<span class="status review">◉ 待教師審核</span>':'<span class="status">再挑戰</span>'}
function clearTimer(){if(timer){clearInterval(timer);timer=null}timerRunning=false;}
function logo(){return `<div class="head"><div><div class="brand">✦ AI 共和國｜核心系統修復計畫</div><div class="sub">互動闖關示範版 · 原創題目與畫面取自上傳 PDF</div></div><div class="headright"><span id="cloudBadge" class="pill">☁ 未連線</span><a class="pill" href="teacher.html">教師後台</a><span class="pill">小隊：${safe(state.group||'尚未登錄')}</span><button class="btn ghost tinybtn" onclick="goHome()">⌂ 回地圖</button></div></div>`;}
function footer(){return `<div class="footer"><span>⚠ ${REMINDER}</span><button class="btn tinybtn download" onclick="exportCSV()">匯出本機闖關紀錄 CSV</button></div>`;}
function wrapper(s){$('app').innerHTML=`<main class="shell">${logo()}${s}${footer()}</main>`;if(window.aiRepublicCloudIndicator)window.aiRepublicCloudIndicator();}
function goHome(){clearTimer();task=null;world=0;renderHome()}
function mapButtons(){return [{w:1,x:26,y:69},{w:2,x:1,y:32},{w:3,x:75,y:33},{w:4,x:60,y:69},{w:5,x:38,y:10}].map(o=>`<button class="hotspot" style="left:${o.x}%;top:${o.y}%" aria-label="進入${WORLDS[o.w-1].name}" title="進入${WORLDS[o.w-1].name}" onclick="openWorld(${o.w})"></button>`).join('')}
function renderHome(){let all=TASKS.filter(t=>t.world>0).length, done=TASKS.filter(t=>t.world>0&&state.answers[t.id]?.status==='done').length,pending=TASKS.filter(t=>t.world>0&&state.answers[t.id]?.status==='review').length;
wrapper(`<div class="card intro"><div class="big">歡迎登入 AI 共和國</div><p class="note">點擊下方的五大區域，尋找線索，輸入答案。固定答案會示範自動檢核；開放題將標記為「待教師審核」。</p><div class="introForm"><input id="groupName" class="field" placeholder="小組名稱（例：星際探險隊）" value="${safe(state.group)}"><button class="btn primary" onclick="saveGroup()">設定小隊名稱</button></div></div><div class="hero mapWrap"><img src="${ASSETS['1']}" alt="AI共和國五大關卡地圖">${mapButtons()}</div><div class="heroCaption"><span>✅ 已通過 ${done}/${all} 題　·　🕒 待審 ${pending} 題</span><span class="mini">可直接點擊原始地圖或下方主題區</span></div><div class="grid">${WORLDS.map(w=>`<button class="world" style="--accent:${w.color}" onclick="openWorld(${w.id})"><div class="em">${w.icon}</div><b>${w.name}</b><small>${w.subtitle}</small><div class="progress"><span style="width:${pct(w.id)}%"></span></div><small>${numDone(w.id)}/6 通過 · ${numPending(w.id)} 待審</small></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="card"><div class="titlebar"><h2>🏁 最終任務</h2><span class="pill">FINAL</span></div><p class="note">找出保護大腦的四字素養解藥。本示範版開放預覽；正式版可設定集滿 5 個章印才能解鎖。</p><button class="btn" onclick="openTask('FINAL')">查看 FINAL 題目 →</button></div>`);}
function saveGroup(){state.group=$('groupName').value.trim().slice(0,40)||'匿名小隊';persist();renderHome()}
function openWorld(w){clearTimer();world=w;task=null;renderWorld()}
function renderWorld(){let w=WORLDS.find(x=>x.id===world);if(!w)return renderHome();let rows=TASKS.filter(t=>t.world===world);wrapper(`<div class="titlebar"><div><div class="sub">第 ${world} 區域</div><h2 style="color:${w.color}">${w.icon} ${w.name}｜${w.subtitle}</h2></div><button class="btn ghost" onclick="goHome()">← 回到五大地圖</button></div><div class="hero"><img src="${ASSETS[w.map]}" alt="${safe(w.name)} 地圖"></div><p class="hint">選擇關卡，查看原始 Canva / PDF 畫面並在下方作答：</p><div class="questGrid">${rows.map(t=>`<button class="btn quest" onclick="openTask('${t.id}')"><b>${t.id}　${safe(t.title)}</b><small>${safe(modeLabel(t.mode))}</small>${stamp(t.id)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`);}
function modeLabel(m){return ({exact:'🔐 輸入密碼',review:'✍ 開放式作答',external:'🌐 外部互動與心得',timed:'⏱ 限時挑戰',select:'🔎 選擇與理由'})[m]||m}
function openTask(id){clearTimer();task=TASKS.find(t=>t.id===id);if(!task)return;world=task.world;slide=0;renderTask()}
function switchSlide(diff){slide=(slide+diff+task.pages.length)%task.pages.length;renderTask()}
function nextTask(){let q=TASKS.filter(x=>x.world===task.world),i=q.findIndex(x=>x.id===task.id);if(i>=0&&i<q.length-1)openTask(q[i+1].id);else if(task.world)openWorld(task.world);else goHome()}
function renderTask(){let t=task,p=t.pages[slide],a=state.answers[t.id];wrapper(`<div class="titlebar"><div class="questionHead"><h2>${t.id}｜${safe(t.title)}</h2>${stamp(t.id)}</div><button class="btn ghost" onclick="${t.world?'openWorld('+t.world+')':'goHome()'}">← 返回關卡列表</button></div><div class="slide"><img src="${ASSETS[p]}" alt="原始 PDF 第 ${p} 頁題目圖，點擊可放大" onclick="zoom(${p})"></div><div class="controls"><button class="btn tinybtn" ${t.pages.length===1?'disabled':''} onclick="switchSlide(-1)">← 上一頁</button><span class="mini">原始 PDF 第 ${p} 頁 · ${slide+1}/${t.pages.length}　（點圖放大）</span><button class="btn tinybtn" ${t.pages.length===1?'disabled':''} onclick="switchSlide(1)">下一頁 →</button></div><div class="card form"><div class="big">${modeLabel(t.mode)}</div><p class="note">${safe(t.notes)}</p>${formByMode(t,a)}</div><div class="controls"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="${t.world?'openWorld('+t.world+')':'goHome()'}">返回關卡</button><button class="btn" onclick="nextTask()">下一個任務 →</button></div>`);}
function formByMode(t,a){if(t.mode==='timed')return `<p class="help">本示範額外製作一個簡易「登出鍵」限時點擊遊戲。PDF 中的原版動畫並未直接匯入。</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="startTimer()">▶ 開始 45 秒挑戰</button><div id="timerGame"></div><label for="answer">操作後，你覺得哪些設計讓人難以登出？</label><textarea id="answer" rows="3" class="field" placeholder="寫出小組的反思">${safe(a?.answer||'')}</textarea><button class="btn" onclick="submitAnswer()">儲存心得，送教師審核</button><div id="feedback"></div>`;
let extra='';if(t.external){extra=`<div class="externalbox"><p>外部活動網址：<a href="${safe(t.external)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${safe(t.external)}</a></p><button class="btn primary" onclick="window.open('${t.external}','_blank','noopener')">開啟外部互動工具 ↗</button><p class="help">注意：僅開啟連結不代表網站已驗證完成。正式版需要回傳完成證明或教師審核。</p></div>`}
if(t.mode==='select'){return `${extra}<label for="selection">判斷結果</label><select id="selection" class="field"><option value="">請選擇</option><option value="1">選項 1 / 真實</option><option value="2">選項 2 / 合成</option><option value="unknown">目前證據不足</option></select><label for="answer">你有哪些具體觀察與理由？</label><textarea id="answer" rows="4" class="field" placeholder="請寫出支持你判斷的證據">${safe(a?.answer||'')}</textarea><p class="help">這種題型要檢查推理理由；不建議只由選項決定正確與否。</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitAnswer()">送出判斷與理由</button><div id="feedback"></div>`}
return `${extra}<label for="answer">${t.mode==='exact'?'請輸入解謎答案':'請輸入小組討論或任務結果'}</label>${t.mode==='exact'?`<input id="answer" class="field" autocomplete="off" placeholder="輸入答案，例如 31" value="${safe(a?.answer||'')}">`:`<textarea id="answer" rows="5" class="field" placeholder="輸入你的理由、觀察、反思或操作成果">${safe(a?.answer||'')}</textarea>`}<p class="help">${t.mode==='exact'?(t.answers.length?'這一題有示範用比對答案（已標示為教師仍需確認），後台正式版應於伺服器驗證。':'本題尚未匯入經教師確認的答案；作答後會列為待審，不會亂判錯。'):'此題以教師確認學生有完成並具備合理理由為主，會標示待審。'}</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitAnswer()">${t.mode==='exact'?'確認並嘗試解鎖':'儲存答案，送教師審核'}</button><div id="feedback"></div>`;}
function normalize(s){return String(s).normalize('NFKC').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\s\u3000]+/g,'')}
function submitAnswer(){let value=$('answer')?.value?.trim()||'',selection=$('selection')?.value||'';if(!value){$('feedback').innerHTML='<div class="feedback warn">請先輸入答案或說明。</div>';return;}let t=task;let previous=state.answers[t.id]||{};let status='review';if(t.mode==='exact'&&t.answers.length){status=t.answers.some(a=>normalize(a)===normalize(value))?'done':'retry'}let data={answer:value,selection:selection,status:status,attempts:(previous.attempts||0)+1,savedAt:new Date().toISOString()};state.answers[t.id]=data;persist();let msg=status==='done'?'🎉 解鎖成功！答案符合示範比對規則。':status==='retry'?'🔐 尚未解鎖：試著重新觀察線索，再輸入一次。':'✍️ 已保留小組答案。若 Firebase 已連線，會送交教師審核；未連線則留在本機。';$('feedback').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback ${status==='done'?'good':status==='retry'?'warn':''}">${msg}</div>`;}
function startTimer(){clearTimer();seconds=45;timerRunning=true;let words=['下一則推薦','你可能喜歡','紅點通知','更多影片','熱門挑戰','追蹤成功','你有新訊息','點擊喜歡','限時廣告','直播中','個人推薦','不要錯過','分享','新影片','登出','稍後再看'];let order=words.map((s,i)=>({s,i})).sort((a,b)=>((a.i*13)%17)-((b.i*13)%17));let box=$('timerGame');box.innerHTML=`<p class="time" id="timetext">45 秒</p><div class="gameGrid">${order.map(x=>`<button ${x.s==='登出'?'class="logout"':''} onclick="hitTimer(${x.s==='登出'})">${x.s}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;timer=setInterval(()=>{seconds--;if($('timetext'))$('timetext').textContent=seconds+' 秒';if(seconds<=0){clearTimer();box.innerHTML='<div class="feedback warn">時間到！重新啟動再試一次。</div>';}},1000)}
function hitTimer(correct){if(!timerRunning)return;if(correct){clearTimer();const used=45-seconds;let a=state.answers['2-2']||{};state.answers['2-2']={...a,timerSeconds:used,status:'review',savedAt:new Date().toISOString()};persist();$('timerGame').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback good">找到登出鍵！耗時 ${used} 秒。記得再寫下反思，送教師審核。</div>`}else{$('timerGame').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<p class="hint">這不是登出鍵，繼續找！</p>')}}
function zoom(p){let m=document.createElement('div');m.className='modal';m.onclick=()=>m.remove();m.innerHTML=`<button class="btn close">✕ 關閉</button><img src="${ASSETS[p]}" alt="放大題目圖">`;document.body.appendChild(m)}
function exportCSV(){let rows=[['小組','關卡','主題','狀態','答案','選項','次數','提交時間','計時秒數']];for(let t of TASKS){let a=state.answers[t.id];if(!a)continue;rows.push([state.group,t.id,t.title,a.status,a.answer||'',a.selection||'',a.attempts||0,a.savedAt||'',a.timerSeconds??''])}let csv='\ufeff'+rows.map(r=>r.map(x=>'"'+String(x??'').replaceAll('"','""')+'"').join(',')).join('\r\n');let url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}));let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='AI共和國_示範闖關紀錄.csv';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000)}
renderHome();
</script><script type="module" src="firebase-client.js"></script></body></html>
